lesson: Freeze the saved bytes and their validated loaded snapshot; require another hash-stable roundtrip before publishing derived digests.
limitations: Do not normalize arbitrary values or reinterpret historical digests to force a match.
A byte identity proof preserves existing source contents, but correction and execution authority remain separate decisions.
Offline correctness is not live provider reliability, semantic success or a completed incident migration.
resolution: Pure freeze_serialized_case validates bytes, checks stable loaded snapshot and derives binding fingerprints from that snapshot. Strict preflight still rejects the original drift and requires new authority for correction.
summary: Compare canonical hashes after deserialization, not merely successful schema roundtrip. Numeric typed defaults can change representation while both snapshots validate.
title: Validação de roundtrip não garante estabilidade do fingerprint
